edges.label: the member bloc that forces briefings and carries amendments outside committee jurisdiction
edges.note: Launched by Rep. Tim Burchett on 22 August 2023 alongside a caucus letter to the Intelligence Community Inspector General, with documented members including Burchett, Luna, Burlison, Moskowitz and Ogles. Its confirmed operational achievement is the 12 January 2024 closed briefing; Ogles is a member without an Oversight seat, which is how the caucus extends reach beyond the committee.

title: Rep. Tim Burchett, 'Rep. Burchett Launches UAP Caucus, Leads Letter to Intelligence Community Inspector General'
